## 2026-08-12 — Events, Sponsors, Branding, Holiday RSVP, Chapter Gear

### Changed

- Updated the Sponsors page to use the same site header, primary navigation, fonts, colors, footer, and responsive behavior as the rest of the website.
- Corrected the Holiday Party RSVP / registration button to the chapter's Zeffy ticket page.
- Replaced the previous chapter logo asset with the newly supplied Central Florida Chapter logo while preserving the existing filename used throughout the site.

### Added
- Added a low-profile "Chapter Gear" section near the bottom of the home page.
- Added the 2026 chapter coin artwork with a "Coming Soon" status and placeholder copy for future ordering information.
- Added this internal website change log for future record keeping.
